about:
# Food Guardian

A standalone World of Warcraft: Forever 1.60.1 addon for food, sleeping-bag and campfire buff tracking.

**Version 1.0.2** · [Release notes](https://github.com/PhatZero/Food-Guardian/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## Features
- Full Window, Compact Bar, and Icon Mode.
- Well Fed, Well-Rested (Cozy Sleeping Bag), Camp Benefits countdowns.
- Sleeping Bag stacks and cooldown, Camp Tent / Boosted Rest lockout.
- Warnings with optional sound, minimap shield, movement/scale/lock controls and settings.

## Commands
- `/fg`: toggle window
- `/fg settings`: options
- `/fg mode full`, `/fg mode compact`, `/fg mode icons`
- `/fg demo healthy`, `/fg demo warning`, `/fg demo off`
- `/fg debug`: diagnostics
- `/fg protected`: last protected-action diagnostic
- `/fg combat on`, `/fg combat off`: automatically hide or show in combat

## EllesmereUI minimap compatibility
When EllesmereUI's minimap module is enabled, EllesmereUI positions Food Guardian's shield launcher in its addon-button row or group. Food Guardian will not move it back onto the minimap rim during timer updates or map resizing. Use **EllesmereUI > Minimap > Ungroup Minimap Buttons** to keep it visible on the row, and EllesmereUI's **Free Move Buttons** option to adjust that row's buttons. In this mode, EllesmereUI owns minimap-button dragging rather than Food Guardian's normal click-and-drag behavior.

Food Guardian's **Show minimap shield launcher** and **Hide in combat** settings continue to control its button. Without EllesmereUI's enabled minimap module, the shield uses its native draggable minimap-rim position. The main tracker remains available with `/fg` if your UI hides addon buttons.

## Installation
Extract the official ZIP under WoW Forever's `Interface/AddOns/` directory so that `FoodGuardian/FoodGuardian.toc` exists, then restart.

## Release pipeline
Source is stored in `addon/` and GitHub Actions packages the same installable `FoodGuardian/` structure. CI runs Lua 5.1 syntax and mocked runtime tests. GitHub releases can optionally upload to CurseForge when Actions credentials are configured. See [publishing instructions](https://github.com/PhatZero/Food-Guardian/blob/main/docs/RELEASING.md).

### Combat-safe countdowns (1.0.3)
New installations keep the tracker visible in combat. Existing users can run `/fg combat off` outside combat to enable it, or `/fg combat on` to hide it. Timers use the last readable aura snapshot and resynchronize when combat ends; changes during combat may not appear immediately. Configuration and minimap refreshes pause in combat.

## Optional class buffs (1.1.0)
Open `/fg settings` → **Class Buffs**. Enable tracking and select individual presets or grouped alternatives for your character; external buffs and temporary weapon enhancements are also optional. Custom helpful auras can be entered by exact name or ID (up to eight), or via `/fg buffadd` and `/fg buffremove`. Preferences are per character. Class timers use the existing out-of-combat snapshot and refresh when combat ends. Weapon enhancements are per hand, not specific poison types. Preset aura names and legacy spellbook support require live Forever QA.

### Combat visibility upgrade
The 1.1b2 build resets the old hide-in-combat preference once so cached timers remain visible by default. If you explicitly prefer hiding afterward, use Settings or `/fg combat on`; `/fg combat off` keeps the tracker visible. `/fg debug` reports the saved combat setting and window state.

releases.notes:
## Food Guardian 1.1.0 — Class Buff Tracking

Stable release of the in-game QA-approved build.

### New features
- Optional class-specific buff tracking for all nine classes, with per-character preferences.
- Track selected external buffs, custom helpful auras by name or spell ID, and temporary weapon enhancements.
- Group interchangeable buffs and configure expiration and missing-buff warnings.

### Interface improvements
- Matching icon-and-timer class buff tiles; full names on mouseover.
- Centered rows, automatic wrapping and complete color-coded borders.
- Full, compact and icon modes retained.

### Combat and reliability
- Cached countdowns remain visible during combat without restricted aura scans.
- Refresh live buff information when combat ends.
- Migrate legacy hide-in-combat preferences once.

Class tracking is opt-in. WoW Forever 1.60.1. No gameplay changes from the QA-approved build.

releases.name: Food Guardian 1.0.3 (Forever)
releases.notes:
## Food Guardian 1.0.3 – Combat-Safe Countdown

### Improvements
- Keep Food Guardian visible during combat with cached food, sleeping bag and camp buff countdowns.
- Continue updating progress bars and low-duration warnings during combat.
- Pause aura and inventory scans, minimap updates and configuration controls during combat.
- Automatically refresh actual buff state after combat ends.
- Preserve all three display modes and existing hide-in-combat preferences. Existing users can run `/fg combat off` outside combat to enable visible timers.

### Notes
- Buffs gained, removed or refreshed in combat may not be reflected until combat ends.
- Lua syntax, runtime mock tests and packaging passed; in-game combat and EllesmereUI validation remain unconfirmed.
- Targets WoW Forever 1.60.1.

releases.notes:
# Food Guardian 1.0.2: EllesmereUI Compatibility

**World of Warcraft: Forever (1.60.1)**

## Fixes
- Improved minimap shield compatibility with EllesmereUI's addon-button row and grouped flyout.
- Prevented routine buff refreshes from overriding externally managed button placement or visibility.
- Exposed the shield texture for correct sizing by compatible minimap managers.
- Restored native minimap placement and dragging when EllesmereUI's minimap module is disabled.
- Preserved combat-hide and minimap visibility preferences.

## Testing
- Added automated regression coverage for external minimap ownership, visibility, resizing, combat hiding, and native fallback.
- Lua syntax, runtime mock tests, and package validation passed on the compatibility build.

Existing settings and all three tracker modes are preserved.

releases.name: Food Guardian 1.0.1 (Forever)
releases.notes:
# Food Guardian v1.0.1

A combat-compatibility and UI stability update for **World of Warcraft: Forever 1.60.1**.

## 🛡️ Combat & Stability
- **Hide during combat by default:** Automatically conceals the tracker, settings window, and minimap launcher when entering combat and restores the appropriate windows afterward.
- **Reduce protected-UI interference:** Suspends periodic buff scanning while combat-hiding is active and prevents dragging/resizing during combat.
- **Safer initialization:** Avoids replacing Blizzard's global slash-command table.
- **Protected-action diagnostics:** Records Blizzard blocked/forbidden-action reports for troubleshooting with `/fg protected`.

## 🧭 Minimap Launcher
- **Accurate edge docking:** Positions the Food Guardian shield on the minimap rim based on its actual dimensions.
- **Resizing support:** Repositions correctly for resized and square minimaps.
- **Drag positioning:** Retains movable minimap button behavior.

## ⚙️ New Settings & Commands
- **Hide Food Guardian during combat** is enabled by default and can be changed in Settings.
- `/fg combat on` or `/fg combat off` for a quick override.
- `/fg protected` to inspect the last reported blocked-action event.
- Full Window, Compact Bar, and Icon Mode remain available.

## ✅ QA
- GitHub Actions Lua 5.1 syntax checks, runtime tests, and ZIP packaging.
- User tested the diagnostic QA build in-game and reported **no further protected-action errors**.

**Notes:** All existing Food Guardian settings are retained. This is a passive buff tracker; it does not automatically use consumables or cast spells.

releases.name: Food Guardian 1.0.0 (Forever)
releases.notes:
# Food Guardian 1.0.0 — First Public Release

**World of Warcraft: Forever (1.60.1)**

## Features
- **Full Window** with detailed countdowns, buff statuses, progress bars, and sleeping bag stack information.
- **Compact Bar** for a streamlined row of three icons and buff timers.
- **Icon Mode** with minimalist status outlines and hover details.
- Tracks **Well Fed**, **Cozy Sleeping Bag / Well-Rested**, and **Camp Benefits**.
- Shows **Camp Tent / Boosted Rest** status in the full tracker.
- **Customizable low-duration warnings** with pulsing indicators and optional sounds.
- Move, scale, or lock the tracker and access it from the minimap shield icon.
- Built-in settings and **healthy/warning demo previews**.

## Commands
- `/fg` — Show or hide the tracker
- `/fg settings` — Open settings
- `/fg mode full` — Detailed view
- `/fg mode compact` — Horizontal timer bar
- `/fg mode icons` — Three-icon view
- `/fg demo healthy` or `/fg demo warning` — Preview visual states
- `/fg demo off` — Return to live tracking
- `/fg debug` — Show diagnostic information

## Installation
Unzip so that `Interface/AddOns/FoodGuardian/FoodGuardian.toc` exists, then restart the game.

## Notes
- The first release targets WoW Forever 1.60.1 only.
- Some aura APIs may report unavailable data while restricted; the addon shows `UNKNOWN` rather than assuming the buff is missing.
- Food Guardian does not automatically use consumables or place camp objects.
